name: actilink-free
$comment: ACTILINK-JD10 rotary double pendulum (pendulum-double-rotary, actilink-*): open-loop free swing from rest (drive in CST with a zero target, the current loop holds i_q = 0). expected.json compares it with the Python twin (design/actilink_lib.py ALTwin). Plant: a 0.3 m arm on the actuator's output (Revolute3D J1, RigidBody3D Arm), link 1 (0.6 m, J2) and link 2 (0.6 m, J3, 40 mm beside link 1) on passive joints with smooth Coulomb+viscous bearing friction. Drive as a bond graph: Uq (MSe) -> 1e [Rw, Lw, Isense] -> EMF (GY) -> 1m [Rotor, FricIn (Stribeck), Wm] -> Gear (TF 1/N) -> 0g [GearSpring: compliance, backlash, contact damping] -> 1o [FricOut] -> J1.drive. Firmware: CurrentLoop 16 kHz, DriveLoop 4 kHz (CST/CSV), the drive's motor and output encoders; AS5048A (SPI) and AS5048B (I2C) chains on both passive joints (14 bit, INL, noise, latency as the read offset).

parameters.name: enc_nrd
parameters.description: AS5048 reads: EtherCAT cycles per new reading (1 = every cycle)

options.text: **Free swing.** The drive is enabled with a zero torque target: the arm is backdriven through the planetary gear, the backlash and the rotor inertia. The twin check of expected.json uses this run.
